summary.text: Cooking Luck Pot is a rank six luck path Immortal Gu House that Fang Yuan assembles from Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's true inheritance records. It inspects luck and cooks luck into forms the user wants.

claims.text: After his time path clone finishes a deduction, Fang Yuan assembles the house in his immortal aperture over half a month of aperture time. He places iron wall Gu and thousands of mortal Gu, burns and cools the forming ball, then adds food path Immortal Gu Cook and his luck path Immortal Gu, including Dog Shit Luck, Qi Luck, Luck Inspection, Connect Luck, and Time Luck. The finished house is bowl-sized, golden with pure white light, empty inside, and stands on eight coiling dragons whose heads hang on the rim as if asleep; six dragons look vivid and two look blurry. Cook, rank seven, sits among its Gu, but the core luck path Immortal Gu are still rank six, so the house stays rank six. Fang Yuan’s clone improved the recorded design; the house cannot carry Gu Immortals into battle and is quite similar to Star Constellation Chessboard. When activated it becomes golden light, rises above his head, and vanishes from ordinary sight.
Deviation (recorded): this page is filed under gu-houses because Cooking Luck Pot is a named Immortal Gu House. It is mobile equipment, not a five-region map seat.

Time Luck, Luck Inspection, Dog Shit Luck, Qi Luck, Connect Luck, and other Immortal Gu supply only basic functions; the main ability is cooking luck, converting forms such as black coffin luck into fortune luck or peach blossom luck inside the pot. That peak creation sits in Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s self luck true inheritance, which studies one’s own luck and how to modify it. At rank six it can barely affect Fang Yuan’s rank eight main-body luck, while clone luck changes more readily.

With Luck Inspection among its cores he can observe clone luck by activating the house alone, cook black cloud death omen luck into milder help for his dragonman clone, and judge the house too low ranked to inspect his own luck fully.

After refining and advancing luck path Immortal Gu taken from a dismantled Cooking Luck Pot, he reassembles it as rank seven Cooking Luck Pot during the Refinement Path Convention stretch. At that rank it can affect rank eight, yet his luck is still too strong for him to see more than a bare portion, and prolonged looking damages the pot until a crack must be fixed at once.

When Qin Ding Ling’s rank eight luck path golden blade tries to cut Fang Yuan’s luck advantage, Cooking Luck Pot appears above him and blocks the strikes; cracks form, but the house stays intact overall. Qin Ding Ling recognizes it at once. She is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s former concubine who knew of the house, and she judges that a rank seven pot cannot block her forever.

Fang Yuan later names Dog Shit Luck the core Immortal Gu of Cooking Luck Pot and the house the peak creation of the essence of the self luck true inheritance. He dismantles the house, advances its luck path Immortal Gu, and with rank eight Dog Shit Luck the house itself advances to rank eight.

After more than two months in the sovereign immortal aperture, the remade house shines golden with occasional platinum light, thicker walls, and eight clear dragon statues instead of the blurry rank seven image. Fang Yuan raises its rank to protect his luck; its structure makes it weak in offense and strong at defending a Gu Immortal’s luck, and it must be used outside the aperture. Its luck path Immortal Gu are all rank eight enough for that defense, while food path Cook remains rank seven for lack of matching materials. Cooking Luck Pot, at rank eight, can finally bear all of Fang Yuan’s luck instead of only the portion inside the pot.
